from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import hashlib, json, re

root = Path('products/services/contracts-finder-small-data-qa')
source = root / 'raw/targeted-data-cleansing.html'
data = source.read_bytes()

class Results(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.parts = []
        self.links = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            href = dict(attrs).get('href', '')
            url = urlsplit(href)
            if url.netloc in ('', 'www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk') and re.fullmatch(r'/Notice/[0-9a-f-]{36}', url.path, re.I):
                self.links.append((url.path, len(self.parts)))
    def handle_data(self, text):
        if text.strip():
            self.parts.append(' '.join(text.split()))

page = Results()
page.feed(data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
terms = re.compile(r'data cleans\w*|data quality|deduplic\w*|data migrat\w*|data reconcil\w*|catalogu\w*|spreadsheet|data validat\w*', re.I)
rows = []
for i, (path, start) in enumerate(page.links):
    stop = page.links[i + 1][1] if i + 1 < len(page.links) else len(page.parts)
    excerpt = ' '.join(page.parts[start:stop])[:850]
    rows.append({'url': 'https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk' + path, 'context_after_link': excerpt, 'navigation_terms': sorted(set(m.group().lower() for m in terms.finditer(excerpt)))})
result = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'scope': 'Navigation only. Text spans adjacent notice links and can include neighboring page elements. Keywords do not establish fit, deadline, or acceptance criteria.', 'link_count': len(rows), 'rows': rows}
output = root / 'description-navigation.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'link_count': len(rows), 'contexts_with_terms': sum(bool(row['navigation_terms']) for row in rows)}))
